sunwayPenang.about: A modern private hospital in Seberang Jaya, Penang, part of Sunway Healthcare Group.
points: A pioneer in robot-assisted surgery and advanced imaging.
Comprehensive care for cancer, neurology, orthopaedics (bones and joints), and heart.
Hundreds of beds with fast, well-organised service.

northernHeart.about: The first hospital in northern Malaysia dedicated to the heart and blood vessels.
points: A modern cardiac catheterisation lab (cath lab), for emergencies and planned procedures.
Dedicated operating theatres for heart and chest surgery.
Care directly from specialist doctors and senior consultant cardiologists.

optimax.about: One of Malaysia's leading eye specialist hospitals.
points: A pioneer in laser vision correction (LASIK, ReLEx SMILE) and modern cataract surgery.
Treats complex eye conditions: glaucoma, retina, children's eyes, and eye tumours.

gleneaglesKL.about: One of the best-known hospitals in Kuala Lumpur, accredited by Joint Commission International (JCI), an international hospital quality standard.
points: Excellent for complex cases: neurology and neurosurgery, heart, and an integrated cancer centre.
Intensive care (ICU/CCU) with advanced medical technology.
Specialists from many fields under one roof.

pantaiKL.about: Founded in 1974, one of the most experienced private hospitals in Kuala Lumpur. Part of IHH Healthcare.
points: Centres of excellence for cancer, orthopaedics and trauma, heart, and mother and child health.
Accredited by JCI and MSQH (Malaysian Society for Quality in Health).
Supported by more than 200 specialists and sub-specialists.

pantaiMelaka.about: Melaka's leading referral hospital, part of IHH Healthcare, one of the largest hospital networks in Asia.
points: Centres of excellence for cancer, heart, orthopaedics, and women's and children's health.
More than 200 beds and more than 80 specialists.
Complete care in a calm city setting.

groups.title: Your body
items: Follow the preparation instructions from your doctor or hospital. If a test needs fasting, we help confirm how long.

groups.title: Documents to bring

Previous results, such as lab tests or X-rays.

items.q: Are DHA's consultation and support free?
items.a: Yes. Consultation, doctor appointments, and airport pickup cost nothing. Medical fees are paid directly to the hospital.
We share treatment and check-up cost information during your consultation, based on the hospital and your needs.

items.q: Which hospitals can I choose from?
items.a: Six partner hospitals in Penang, Kuala Lumpur, and Melaka. We help you choose the right one.

items.q: How long from consultation to departure?
items.a: It depends on the doctor's availability and your needs. Our team gives you an estimate during the consultation.
Yes. We recommend hotels close to the hospital.
A passport valid for at least 6 months, previous results if available, and your tickets and doctor schedule.
